name: system-maintenance
tagline: Backup, Update & Protect Your AI Infrastructure
description: Unified system maintenance: backup and restore with DEFCON-style audit logging, automated update detection and execution via GitHub Releases, pre-update safety backups, rollback support, and version tracking across all services.
shortDescription: Backup, update, restore, and maintain your entire QuoxCORE installation.
author: QUOX
marketingPoints: One-click system updates with automatic safety backups
GitHub Release integration with changelog display
Full and selective backup with SHA-256 verification
DEFCON-style audit logging for all operations
Rolling service restart with health verification
Rollback to any previous version from pre-update backup
Automated backup scheduling (hourly, daily, weekly, monthly)

updateDetection.name: Update Detection
updateDetection.description: Automatic version checks against GitHub Releases. Get notified when new versions are available.

updateExecution.name: One-Click Updates
updateExecution.description: Apply updates with automatic pre-update backup, rolling service restart, and health verification.

rollback.name: Rollback
rollback.description: Instantly revert to a previous version using the pre-update backup. Never get stuck on a bad release.

fullBackup.name: Full Backup
fullBackup.description: Backup all critical components including databases, memory, uploads, workflows, and configurations.

selectiveBackup.name: Selective Backup
selectiveBackup.description: Choose specific components to backup — databases, uploads, n8n workflows, agent configs, and more.

verification.name: SHA-256 Verification
verification.description: Cryptographic proofs ensure backup integrity. Verify archives haven't been tampered with.

scheduling.name: Automated Scheduling
scheduling.description: Configure recurring backups — hourly, daily, weekly, or monthly with retention policies.

auditLogging.name: DEFCON Audit Logging
auditLogging.description: Military-style audit trail with risk levels (GREEN→RED) for all backup, restore, and update operations.

versionTracking.name: Version Tracking
versionTracking.description: Every service reports its version in health checks. See at a glance if all services are running the same version.

changes: Merged backup-restore into unified System Maintenance plugin
Added update detection via GitHub Releases
Added one-click update execution with pre-update backup
Added rollback support from pre-update backups
Added version tracking across all services
Added update history and settings management
